available: Pipelines as code
Typed YAML: steps, dependencies, conditions, loops, run inputs, outputs passed between steps, reusable templates pinned by Git tag.
Triggers
Push, pull request (new pushes cancel older runs), manual, schedule and webhook.
High availability
Several servers on PostgreSQL; a run survives a server or runner dying. SQLite for a single server.
Secure step execution
Non-root step pods under strict Kubernetes pod security; container and host executors.
Test results
Tests tab from JUnit XML and Go test output, with history and flaky detection.
Security scans
Secret scan, SAST, dependency, licence, IaC and image findings (SARIF) and SBOM components.
Container image builds
Build, scan, sign and push images with provenance and SBOM through BuildKit.
GitOps delivery with Argo CD
Deploy by Git commit, watch sync, control Argo Rollouts (promote, abort, retry), rollback, environment locks.
Approvals and protected environments
Approval steps; the person who started a run cannot approve its production deploy.
Policy gates
Rules pipelines cannot opt out of, at run start, before deploys and image pushes; report or enforce; audited, expiring waivers.
Sign-in and access
OIDC sign-in with groups, roles per project and environment, scoped API tokens, CLI, audit trail.
Public documentation site and roadmap
GitHub Pages site with diagrams, tutorials, install guides and this roadmap; short README.
Built-in artifact storage
Artifacts, test attachments and hosted reports are kept in the database: several servers share them with nothing else to run. S3 and a shared directory remain options.
Rich test, coverage and HTML reports
Test results in 13 formats (JUnit, Playwright, Cucumber and Karate, mochawesome, TRX and more) with screenshots and video, coverage with thresholds, and the tools' own HTML reports hosted sandboxed.
MCP server for AI agents
Agents write and validate pipelines, start and watch runs and diagnose failures through /mcp, with the same permissions as the token they hold.
Verification step with optional AI
Canary and post-deploy analysis on Prometheus, Loki, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL and JSON APIs; automatic abort or rollback; AI explains, never turns a failure into a pass.
Runner identity and pools
Each runner has its own key and joins with a token; runners serve only the projects of their pool; runner-side allow-lists protect your network.

items.title: All configuration in the database, one API
items.value: No file-first configuration: projects, pools, environments, policies and more live in the database with history and audit, managed through UI, API, CLI, MCP and Terraform.

items.title: Public demo on the internet
items.value: A separate, safe instance with realistic demo data anyone can explore, isolated from your real pipelines and network.

items.title: Graphical setup wizards
items.value: Every setup task asks plain questions, explains each option and its effect, validates as it goes and shows what it will create.

items.title: Built-in accounts with MFA
items.value: Small teams without an identity provider still get secure sign-in with TOTP or passkeys.

items.title: Signed releases and installers
items.value: Verified downloads, deb/rpm packages, a one-line VM install with systemd, and a runner-only Helm chart.

items.title: Terraform provider
items.value: Projects, environments, pools, policies, roles and more managed as code.

items.title: Built-in Helm and Kubernetes deploys
items.value: Deploy and roll back without Argo CD; Argo stays first class for long-lived environments.

items.title: Preview environments per branch or pull request
items.value: Every pull request gets its own environment and URL, tested automatically and cleaned up on merge.

items.title: Organisations (multi-tenant)
items.value: Installation, Organisation, Unit and Project levels with names you can change; unused levels stay hidden.

items.title: Hosted service
items.value: Offer Launchway as SaaS: sign-up, quotas, usage metering, data residency, customer-side logs and artifacts.

items.title: LDAP, Active Directory and custom roles
items.value: Directory groups mapped to roles at each level, automatic removal of leavers, and a 'who can do what, and why' view.

items.title: Delivery metrics and executive dashboards
items.value: Deployment frequency, lead time from commit to production, change failure rate and time to restore, with drill-down.

items.title: Tamper-evident audit and SIEM export
items.value: An audit trail nobody can quietly edit, streamed to your security tools.

items.title: Change management
items.value: Automatic change records with risk scores, freezes and CAB approval; optional ServiceNow and Jira Service Management.

items.title: Post-deploy watch, incidents and SLOs
items.value: Keep watching after release, roll back automatically, tie incidents to the change that caused them.

items.title: Service mesh and traffic control
items.value: Weighted canaries through Gateway API, Istio, Linkerd or Cilium, with mesh metrics as ready-made health checks.

items.title: Argo CD in depth
items.value: App-of-apps and ApplicationSet trees, a ready Lua health-check library, hosted or bring-your-own Argo CD.

items.title: Terraform/OpenTofu and Ansible steps
items.value: Reviewed plans, gated applies, built-in state with locking, drift detection; Ansible with per-host results.

items.title: Single pane of glass
items.value: One fleet view across VMs, on-prem clusters and clouds: what runs where, its health, drift and evidence.

items.title: Compliance pack (PCI DSS, HIPAA)
items.value: Policy templates and an evidence report mapping controls to requirements. Evidence support, not certification.

items.title: Retention, legal hold, encryption at rest
items.value: Control how long data is kept, prove deletion, encrypt logs and artifacts with rotating keys; FIPS build option.

items.title: Cloud and serverless targets
items.value: Cloud Run, Lambda, ECS, managed instance groups and auto-scaling groups, with no stored cloud keys.

items.title: VM deploys and Packer images
items.value: Batch deploys over SSH with verification between batches; baked machine images rolled through instance groups.

items.title: Releases across services
items.value: Ship several services as one ordered, gated release with a promotion view across environments.

items.title: Smaller integrations
items.value: Chat approvals, feature-flag mitigation, Chef templates, dependency caches, more event sources.
